ovh_endpoint.description: OVH API endpoint region (e.g., ovh-eu, ovh-ca, kimsufi-eu, soyoustart-eu)

ovh_application_key.description: OVH API Application Key (obtained when registering an OVH API application)

ovh_application_secret.description: OVH API Application Secret (obtained when registering an OVH API application)

ovh_consumer_key.description: OVH API Consumer Key (must be generated with permissions for /cloud, /dedicated, /me, and /ip)

timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for each API request

retry.description: Number of times to retry failed API calls

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr

legacy_api.description: Use legacy /api/ovh endpoint instead of /api/me (required for some older OVH accounts)

servers.description: List of managed OVH servers (cloud or bare metal) to fence

name.description: Unique identifier for this server entry (used as section name)

domain.description: OVH domain name associated with the server (e.g., 'example.com')

ipmi_ip.description: IPMI/IPMI-LAN address for out-of-band power control (if using IPMI instead of OVH API)

power_wait.description: Seconds to wait after power-on command before checking status (default: 10)

use_ipmi.description: If true, use local IPMI to fence this node instead of OVH API (useful for bare-metal)
